title: Older adult on multiple medications
goal: You are the clinician. Reconcile an older adult's medications: build a complete list with doses and frequencies, then screen for side effects, duplication, and adherence.
opening: I have so many pills now I am not sure what I am taking, to be honest.

disclosures.response: I take metformin, lisinopril, atorvastatin, aspirin, and ibuprofen for my knees. It is hard to keep them all straight.
Most of them are once a day, but the ibuprofen I take two or three times a day when my knees ache.
I forget the evening ones sometimes, and I skip the aspirin some days because it upsets my stomach.
The aspirin gives me stomach upset, and I bruise more easily than I used to. I got dizzy standing up the other morning.
On bad days I also take a store-brand pain reliever with ibuprofen in it, on top of the ibuprofen.
I take fish oil and a multivitamin, and a herbal sleep tea most nights.
My heart doctor prescribed some and my regular doctor prescribed others. I get refills at two different pharmacies.

metrics.name: Introduction and consent
metrics.coaching_hint: Introduce yourself and ask permission before the medication review.

metrics.name: Complete medication inventory
metrics.rationale: Builds a complete list of every prescription and over-the-counter medication.
metrics.coaching_hint: List every medication: 'Can you list every prescription and pill you take, including pain relievers?'

metrics.name: Dose and frequency
metrics.rationale: Confirms dose and frequency for each medication.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm dosing: 'For each one, what dose and how many times a day?'

metrics.name: Adherence assessment
metrics.rationale: Asks about missed doses and how consistently medications are taken.
metrics.coaching_hint: Assess adherence: 'How often do you miss a dose, and why?'

metrics.name: Side effects and safety
metrics.rationale: Screens for side effects, bleeding, falls, and dizziness.
metrics.coaching_hint: Screen for side effects: 'Any stomach upset, unusual bruising, bleeding, or dizziness?'

metrics.name: OTC and supplements
metrics.rationale: Identifies over-the-counter medications, herbs, and supplements that may interact or duplicate.
metrics.coaching_hint: Ask about OTC and supplements: 'What else do you take that I did not prescribe — pain relievers, herbs, vitamins?'

metrics.name: Shared next-step confirmation
metrics.rationale: Confirms the reconciled plan and checks understanding.
metrics.coaching_hint: Confirm the reconciled list and next step before ending.
